displayName: OCI-API-003: API3: Broken Object Property Level Authorization (BOPLA)
description:
Detects API responses returning sensitive properties that the user should not access

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_api_003", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%api3%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%broken%') AND "value" > 0
